title: Snip and Thrift
description: Drive-thru discount surgery performed by a refurbished arcade-claw robot, nineteen ninety-nine while you wait.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-surgery
lines.text: Point at any organ you want gone, our claw machine yanks it for nineteen ninety-nine. <p:0.2> Snip and Thrift. Why pay retail to keep all your organs?

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Claw selects organ at random. <p:0> Anesthesia is a complimentary mint. <p:0> Wrong kidney is final sale. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
